question: For the NXT title that had the shortest match (excluding titles with "title change"), what were the names of the two wrestlers involved?
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT w_winner.name AS winner_name, w_loser.name AS loser_name
FROM Matches m
JOIN Belts b ON m.title_id = b.id
JOIN Wrestlers w_winner ON m.winner_id = w_winner.id
JOIN Wrestlers w_loser ON m.loser_id = w_loser.id
WHERE b.name = 'NXT Championship'
  AND m.title_change = 0
  AND m.duration = '00:43'
